title: TB4 Fluorescence Immunohistochemistry
author: Vinay Saunders
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rwcd7aw
materials: The primary antibodies used were as follows:rabbit anti-thymosin β4 polyclonal antibody used at 1:1500 dilution (Millipore Cat# AB6019, RRID:AB_10806893); mouse anti-myosin heavy chain monoclonal antibody used at 1:50 dilution (Thermo Fisher Scientific Cat# 50-6503-80, RRID:AB_2574266); mouse anti-SMA monoclonal antibody used at 1:100 dilution (Leica Microsystems Cat# NCL-SMA, RRID:AB_442134); sheep anti-CD31 polyclonal antibody used at 1:2000 dilution (R and D Systems Cat# AF806, RRID:AB_355617). The secondary antibodies used were as follows:goat anti-rabbit IgG-FITC at 1:200 dilution (Sigma-Aldrich Cat# F6005, RRID:AB_259682); goat anti-mouse IgG-Alexa Fluor 594 at 1:200 dilution (Thermo Fisher Scientific Cat# A-11005, RRID:AB_2534073); donkey anti-sheep IgG-Alexa Fluor 555 at 1:400 dilution (Thermo Fisher Scientific Cat# A21436, RRID:AB_10376163).

steps.title: Fix and dehydrate tissue
steps.instruction: Fix the tissue in 4% PFA overnight and dehydrate it the following day.

substeps.instruction: Wash tissue for 2 hours each in 70%, 80%, 90%, and 100% ethanol.

steps.title: Embed and store tissue
steps.instruction: Embed the tissue in paraffin wax, allow it to set, and store at 4ºC.

steps.title: Section tissue
steps.instruction: Cut 10 micron thick sections from tissue blocks using a Leica rotary microtome and mount them onto aminoalkylsilane-coated glass slides.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and rehydrate sections
steps.instruction: Prepare sections for staining by removing paraffin and rehydrating.

substeps.instruction: Wash sections with xylene, ethanol (100%, 90%, and 70%), and distilled water.

steps.title: Perform antigen retrieval
steps.instruction: Boil slides in 0.01 mol/L sodium citrate solution (pH 6.0) + 0.05% Tween 20 for 15 mins.

steps.title: Stain with antibodies
steps.instruction: Apply primary and secondary antibodies diluted in PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 + 3% serum.

substeps.instruction: Incubate secondary antibodies for 1 hour at room temperature.
For triple-stained sections, perform secondary antibody treatments consecutively if required to prevent cross-reactivity.
Use sections stained with secondary antibodies alone as negative controls.

steps.title: Dehydrate stained sections
steps.instruction: Dehydrate sections using a series of ethanol and xylene treatments.

substeps.instruction: Treat for 2 min each in 70%, 90%, and 100% ethanol.
Treat for 2 min twice in xylene.

steps.title: Mount and counterstain
steps.instruction: Prepare slides for storage and imaging.

substeps.instruction: Counterstain nuclei using Vectashield Mounting Medium with DAPI (Vector Laboratories).

steps.title: Image slides
steps.instruction: Image the slides using a standard fluorescence microscope or a Leica SP5 confocal microscope.
